title: Lubricant R&D external collaboration record (outsourced test / fabrication / datasheet)
description: External collaboration record (WP-10): one batch of data obtained outside the project boundary — an outsourced test (外检), an outsourced fabrication/service (外协), or a vendor-published datasheet. A resource object like bench (WP-05) and interface (WP-09), not a chain stage. Fail-closed rule (plan acceptance): an external record MUST carry data_usage_rights_reference naming the contract / data-usage agreement that authorises our use of the data; a record without it cannot be imported (enforced at preflight, never defaulted). Provenance alignment with WP-12 claim_class: evidence items carried on an external record are naturally THIRD_PARTY_LAB (independent lab measurement) or MANUFACTURER_DATASHEET (vendor-published, unverified) — never INTERNAL_TEST (own controlled measurement is recorded by its own producing skill) — and stay ungraded when omitted. experiment.schema.json and interface.schema.json carry an optional external_record_reference citing this artifact as EXTERNAL:<external_id>.

project_reference.description: Project this record is made for; also used as the artifact project_id by the builder.

record_type.description: EXTERNAL_TEST = outsourced test (外检); EXTERNAL_SERVICE = outsourced fabrication/service (外协); MANUFACTURER_DATASHEET = vendor-published data.

provider.description: Name of the external party that produced the data (lab, fabrication house, or vendor).

data_usage_rights_reference.description: Mandatory (plan WP-10 acceptance): reference to the contract / NDA / data-usage agreement that grants the right to use this data. Missing or empty is rejected — external data without a usage-rights anchor never enters the project evidence base.
